name: Wicked Reflection
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
description: Ornate full-length mirrors with fiendish filigree depict the image of Fasiel ibn Sazadin in villainous triumph over his enemies.
disable: DC 21 Stealth check (trained) to approach a mirror without showing up in the reflection, followed by DC 19 Thievery check to cover mirror or dispel magic (2nd level; counteract DC 19) to counteract the binding

offensiveAbilities.name: Release Rakshasa
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The mirror breaks

Effect The mirror releases a Raktavarna rakshasa. The raktavarna rolls initiative and remains for 3 rounds, after which the spell ends and the rakshasa disappears. The summoned raktavarna can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fiend's Luck
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Fasiel is within 100 feet, this is the closest intact wicked reflections hazard, and a hostile creature's action would cause Fasiel to gain the Blinded, Confused, controlled, Fascinated, Immobilized, Paralyzed, petrified, Restrained, slowed, stunned, or Unconscious condition or would deal 20+ damage to Fasiel

Effect The mirror breaks and disrupts the action.
